profile_text.body:
DeepL is a for-profit AI translation company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Cologne, Germany. The company describes itself as offering an end-to-end, AI-first translation platform that handles text, files, media formats, and voice, and it provides a developer-facing API for integration into third-party workflows. Its core product is built on a specialized large language model trained on proprietary data by thousands of language experts, which the company says delivers accuracy and personalized experiences across languages.

DeepL's primary tracked product is its translation service, noted as EU-hosted, and the platform is positioned to serve both individual users and enterprise clients. The company's site cites Cybozu and Daiwa Securities as customers, describing use cases that include breaking language barriers in global collaboration and accelerating digital transformation by reducing outsourcing costs in areas such as international investor-relations reporting.

The held facts show no litigation on record. One MCP server entry appears in the registry under the name "ai.deepledger/mcp," described as an AI accountant tool for QuickBooks covering recording, reconciliation, and month-end close, though this entry appears to be associated with a separate entity called Deep Ledger rather than DeepL itself.
